description: READ ONLY. Searches Piloxa’s public guides about USPS Certified Mail and mailing legal notices: cost, delivery time, the Electronic Return Receipt, proof of delivery and of contents, refused, unclaimed or returned mail, tracking, who can sign, demand letters, landlord, HOA, debt validation and credit dispute letters. Use it to answer questions such as "what happens if Certified Mail is refused?" with a citable source. Returns up to 8 results, each with an id for fetch, a title, the page URL, an excerpt and a relevance score. Searches public pages only; no person’s letters are searchable.

limit.description: How many results, 1 to 8. Defaults to 5.

query.description: The question or keywords, e.g. "certified mail refused".

name: search
title: Search Piloxa’s Certified Mail guides
